title: fix(runtime)!: POST /keys refuses a body key it does not read
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB14kEpfd2LvsygyiKr2w7u2)_

Fixes #32281

Clause-②: yes (narrowing): `POST /keys` with a body key outside the accepted set answered 201 and now answers 400
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — `skills/**` teaches no `POST /api/v1/keys` body (zero hits for `/api/v1/keys`, `keys.create` or `POST /keys` under `skills/`), so no skill text describes the dropped keys.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：创建 API Key 的接口（`POST /api/v1/keys`）现在只收 `name` 和 `expires_at` 两个字段，带了别的字段（比如 `userId`、`scopes`、组织字段或拼错的字段）一律回 `400 VALIDATION_FAILED`，并逐个点名是哪些字段，不再建 key。
- 为什么改：以前这些字段被悄悄丢掉、照样回 201，调用方以为给别人建了 key 或建了带权限范围的 key，其实拿到的是给自己建的普通 key，被误导。
- 风险与回滚：属于收窄（BREAKING）：曾经带多余字段也能成功的脚本会开始收到 400。平台自带的调用方（SDK、控制台两个建 key 页面、Setup 里的 Create Key 按钮）只发这两个字段，不受影响。回滚即还原 `packages/runtime/src/domains/keys.ts` 这一处。
- 先看：`packages/runtime/src/domains/keys.ts`（`refuseUnreadKeysBody` 与其调用点，在任何读写之前）；`packages/runtime/src/http-dispatcher.keys.test.ts`（末尾新增的 #32281 套件与改判的三条旧用例）；`.changeset/32281-keys-refuse-unknown-body-keys.md`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/http-dispatcher.keys.test.ts`，预期 26 项全过；其中 `{ name, userId }` 回 400、`fields[0].field` 为 `userId`、不落任何行。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`packages/runtime/src/domains/keys.ts` — the one `/keys` door (the dispatcher is the only transport that serves it; `packages/rest` mounts no `/keys`).

- New `refuseUnreadKeysBody`: the accepted set is `name` and `expires_at` (measured on `main` at de141e32: the handler reads exactly `body.name` and `body.expires_at`, nothing else). Any other key is answered `400 VALIDATION_FAILED` through the shared `validationFailure` constructor, with one `error.details.fields[]` entry per key (`code: 'unknown_field'`, the ADR-0114 member the `_activation` doors use). A body that is an array or a primitive is refused naming `(body)` / `invalid_type`. An absent body, `null` or `{}` still mints the default-named key.
- It runs right after the method check, ahead of the expiry read, every service lookup (`objectql`, `tenancy`, `auth`), the membership read and the insert, so nothing is read or written for a refused body.
- The file header's "body is whitelisted … any `key` / `id` / `user_id` / `revoked` in the body is ignored" bullet is rewritten to the refusal; the row comment notes the refusal is the caller's answer while the row stays server-built.

First-party caller census (all send only accepted keys, none changed):

| Caller | Where | Body |
|---|---|---|
| SDK `client.keys.create` | `packages/client/src/index.ts:6646-6656` | `name`, `expires_at` |
| Console Integrations page | `ui/apps/console/src/pages/developer/AgentConnectSection.tsx:138-142` | `{ name }` |
| Connect-an-agent widget | `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/connect/ConnectAgentWidget.tsx:328-333` | `{ name }` |
| `sys_api_key` Create Key action | `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-api-key.object.ts:99-127` (params `name`, `expires_at`; no `bodyExtra`, no `bodyShape`, not an `/api/v1/auth/` target, so the action door's `buildApiActionRequest` adds nothing) | `name`, `expires_at`; pinned by `setup-list-empty-states.test.ts:163` |
| CLI, MCP | no mint caller (`packages/cli/src`, `packages/mcp/src` only mention the route in help text) | — |

## Tests

`packages/runtime/src/http-dispatcher.keys.test.ts`:

- New suite `unknown body keys (#32281)`: one unknown key (`userId`) → 400 `VALIDATION_FAILED`, `fields` = `[userId / unknown_field]`, message first sentence, no row, and **no service looked up** (a counting kernel records zero lookups); several keys named together in body order (`scopes`, `user_id`, `nmae`); a `userId` for another user leaves the caller's row count unchanged and no row for `u2`; non-object bodies (`['name']`, `'ci'`, `42`) → `(body)`; CONTROL `{ name }` and `{ name, expires_at }` → 201, absent body → 201 named "API Key".
- Re-judged (they pinned the silent drop): "pins user_id to the caller" → refused, no row; "ignores body-injected key/id/revoked" → refused naming `key`, `id`, `revoked`, `prefix`, no `osk_` in the answer; "ignores an organization supplied in the body" → refused naming the three org keys, no row, plus a new 201 control that the key is still pinned to the active organization.
- `packages/runtime/src/domain-handler-registry.test.ts`: the registry-reaches-the-handler case sent `user_id: 'attacker'`; it now sends `{ name }` (the refusal is pinned in the keys test).
- `packages/runtime/test-typecheck-debt.json`: the keys test's `TS18048` count shrank 9 → 8 (two rewritten cases read through `responseOf`); re-recorded with `gen:test-typecheck-debt`.

## Acceptance notes

- The non-object `(body)` refusal goes one step past the card's wording (keys outside the accepted set): without it an array or string body would be named by its indices (`0`, `1`). Declared here and in the changeset; both are the same narrowing.
- No docs page states the old ignore (`content/docs/**` only shows the bare `curl -X POST …/keys`, which still answers 201), so no docs change.

## Verification

Ablations (each committed first, mutated with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, restored to `HEAD` with `git diff HEAD` empty):

<details><summary>Ablation 1 — the unknown-key refusal put back to "drop"</summary>

Anchor `if (unread.length === 0) return undefined;` → `if (unread.length >= 0 /* ablated-32281 */) return undefined;` (anchor 1 → 0, blob ce6c6daf → cb45d5fd). `vitest run src/http-dispatcher.keys.test.ts`: **6 failed | 20 passed** — the three re-judged cases and the three unknown-key cases, each at `expect(res.body.error.code).toBe('VALIDATION_FAILED')`. Restored: blob == HEAD (ce6c6daf).
</details>

<details><summary>Ablation 2 — the non-object refusal removed</summary>

Anchor `if (typeof body !== 'object' || Array.isArray(body)) {` → `if (false /* ablated-32281b */) {`. **1 failed | 25 passed** (`refuses a body that is not an object, naming (body)`). Restored: blob == HEAD.
</details>

<details><summary>Local runs</summary>

- `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/runtime^...' build` — VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime typecheck` (tsc + `check:test-typecheck`) — OK, 27 files / 185 errors / 66 signatures held.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` — **Test Files 580 passed (580), Tests 10976 passed | 19 skipped** — VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config` on the three touched source files — exit 0.
</details>

<details><summary>Derived gates (dispatch-gates --commands, 67 families at 32b6ebdd)</summary>

Round 1, serial, each exit captured before any pipe: 63 exit 0. The four non-zero, and what was done:

- `pnpm check:error-code-casing` exit 1 — the new test compared `f.code === 'unknown_field'` (read as a lowercase `error.code` comparison). Rewritten to `expect.objectContaining({ field, code })` in 5641887e; the gate then answered `✓ no unlisted lowercase error codes in 12142 scanned file(s)`.
- `pnpm check:test-source-alias` exit 1 — both edited test files reach the dynamic `import('@objectstack/metadata')` (`standalone-stack.ts`) through `http-dispatcher`; each now imports it at module top, as the package's other dispatcher tests do (1baf71f3). Gate then OK (`the source reach judged 2 test file(s)`).
- `node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` exit 3 — shallow clone (prerequisite, not a verdict). After `git fetch --unshallow`: exit 0, `48 cases pass`.
- `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exit 3 — needs built `dist/` for 36 packages (prerequisite, nothing measured); re-run after the dogfood closure build, reading in the os-dev-report.

`pnpm lint` on the touched files (`eslint --no-inline-config`): exit 0 (one `as any` service-lookup finding in the new test fixed before commit).

The final head merges `origin/main` (3191e007) through `scripts/pm/os-regen-merge.sh` (no generated path moved on both sides). The derived set re-run on the final head, and its `--ran` reconciliation, are in the os-dev-report comment on #32281.
</details>

Full dogfood battery (owed by the narrowing arm): run on the final head; its reading is in the os-dev-report comment on #32281.
